packs.name: Magic and fantasy stages
packs.author: Mixed artists, including CraftPix / Free Game Assets and other paid asset-pack creators
packs.source: Imported source pack folder: app/extraFiles/samples/atlas/stages; representative verified source: https://craftpix.net/file-licenses/
packs.licenseSummary: Not release-approved as a public GitHub asset library. CraftPix/Free Game Assets licenses allow use in games, but explicitly do not permit distributing source art files in a way that lets end users reuse the art. Several retained folders are paid asset packs with no bundled redistribution grant.
packs.attribution: Keep creator attribution per original pack if used in a compiled game; do not publish the raw stage pack files in this repository without explicit redistribution permission.

packs.name: Ansimuz environment collection

packs.attribution: Credit Luis Zuno / Ansimuz for covered art. Preserve local public-license files. Credit bundled music/audio authors such as Pascal Belisle where retained.
